# Awesome Jev Prompts

> A curated library of 60 question patterns, anti-patterns, and calibration notes for typed decision models — Jev and every System One-compatible engine (Clef, StartLux, d3, SGLang). Question design is the prompt engineering of typed decisions — and question wording is the portable part.

Facts: Jev 1.14 is the latest release; POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, $0.042/1M input tokens (output free), 64k context (32k state + longest question), 250k tokens/sec, 1,200 req/min, text-only. Multiple compatible engines exist: Clef (Cloudflare, Apache-2.0), StartLux (open weights, free 27B hosting), SGLang /v1/decisions (any Jinja-template chat model), vllm-jev (local, 24+ open checkpoints). Core rule: questions describe judgments; code owns composition, thresholds, and side effects.

## Tools

- [Question linter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/scripts/lint_questions.py): stdlib-only linter checking atomicity, option-count limits (26 A-Z wire cap), rubric bounds (2-10 levels), escape options, operational Noul boundaries. Exit 1 on errors.
- [Engine Cookbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/README.md#ask-the-same-question-on-every-engine): one question trio rendered across 5 verified engines (Jev, StartLux, SGLang, Clef, vllm-jev) with portability notes on option caps, none-of-the-above, thinking modes, and calibration drift.

## Index — 10 categories, 60 entries

- [Choice patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/choice-patterns.md): intent routing, tool selection, model routing, best-of-N, document classification, skill routing, research conviction scoring
- [Score patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/score-patterns.md): severity rubrics, quality gates, moderation, RAG relevance, priority queues
- [Noul patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/noul-patterns.md): policy checks, duplicate detection, citation checks, human escalation, retry control
- [Routing & triage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/routing-and-triage.md): inbox triage, ticket queues, RAG filtering, document streams, confidence-gated reasoning (AutoThink), market regime routing
- [Guardrails & verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/guardrails-and-verification.md): LLM output guardrails, jailbreak detection, structured-output validation, code review gates, alignment-failure screening, injection-screening gate, signal-vs-noise screening
- [Context compaction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/context-compaction.md): keep-or-drop, summarize-or-quote, tool-result pruning
- [Anti-patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/anti-patterns.md): the ways Jev questions go wrong, with fixes
- [Calibration & eval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/calibration-and-eval.md): thresholds from logged distributions, versioned questions, consistency checks, shadow mode, System Two handoff
- [Embodied & multimodal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/embodied-multimodal-patterns.md): consult gating, capability sheets in state, mission contracts, schema-aware criteria, consequence-bounded Noul, multimodal state binding, per-axis control, evidence-not-instructions clauses
- [Structured-state patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/structured-state-patterns.md): column semantics in state, tabular FM as cheap gate, cross-paradigm calibration

## Ecosystem notes

Dated, link-checked entries tracking the decision-model ecosystem: hyperscaler arrivals (OpenAI, Microsoft, AWS, Perplexity), open-weights parity on Chinese benchmarks, serving-layer convergence on /v1/systemone, trading-agent adoption (TradingAgents 117k★, ai-hedge-fund 64k★), JevAny multi-backbone infrastructure.
